title: Moving the team meeting
instructionsFr: Écoutez le dialogue entre trois collègues, puis répondez aux six questions. Vous pouvez réécouter l'enregistrement autant de fois que nécessaire.

script.title: Moving the team meeting
script.contextFr: Trois collègues, Emma, Jack et Priya, cherchent un nouveau créneau pour la réunion d'équipe de jeudi, car un client important a demandé une démonstration au même moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi both. Thanks for jumping on so quickly. I've got a bit of a problem with Thursday's team meeting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh no, what's up? I thought we'd already agreed on ten o'clock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We did, but the client from Leeds has just asked for a demo at that exact time. I can't really say no, they've been waiting for weeks.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Well, could we move ours to the afternoon? I'm free after two, as long as I'm out by four. I have to pick up my daughter from school.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Afternoon's tricky for me, to be honest. I'm working from home on Thursday, and my internet's being fixed between one and three.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. What about Friday morning, then? Nine thirty, maybe?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Friday works for me. I'd rather not start any earlier, though.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Friday's fine, but I haven't finished the release report yet. If we meet on Friday, I'll send it to you both tomorrow evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Perfect. Let's do Friday at nine thirty, then. I'll update the invitation as soon as we hang up.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great. And Emma, good luck with the demo. Let us know how it goes.

items.prompt: Why does Emma want to change the meeting?
options: A client wants a demo at the same time
The meeting room is not free
items.answer: A client wants a demo at the same time
items.explanationFr: Emma dit que le client de Leeds a demandé une démonstration à l'heure exacte de la réunion.

items.prompt: Why can't Priya stay in a Thursday afternoon meeting after four?
options: She has to collect her daughter
items.answer: She has to collect her daughter
items.explanationFr: Priya dit « I have to pick up my daughter from school » : pick up signifie aller chercher.

items.prompt: Jack can attend a meeting on Thursday between one and three.
items.explanationFr: Entre une heure et trois heures, son accès internet est en réparation, donc il n'est pas disponible.

items.prompt: When do they finally decide to meet?
items.explanationFr: Emma propose vendredi à neuf heures trente et tous acceptent.

items.prompt: Priya has already finished the release report.
items.explanationFr: Elle dit « I haven't finished the release report yet » : present perfect avec yet, le rapport n'est pas terminé.

items.prompt: What will Emma do when the call ends?
items.explanationFr: « As soon as we hang up » : après une conjonction de temps, on utilise le présent (hang up), pas le futur.
